reply.summary: Rnneia is a hermit spirit woven from lightless smoke, raised in a mountain cloister and now wandering the high passes. She can thin into vapour to slip through stone and keeps a cold, patient temper toward anyone who tries to chase her out of the dark.

feats.scene: Rnneia pours her whole body into a black tide that splits a stone bridge in two.
Rnneia scatters into mist as a landslide passes through her and then draws herself whole again.

reply.summary: Niuiutan is a street mage who bends his own flesh into new forms and shelters outcasts from the authorities in a derelict depot. His craft is rough and half understood, but he is loyal to those he hides.

feats.scene: Niuiutan reshapes his arm into a hammer and caves in a steel shutter.
Niuiutan takes a thrown crate on his softened chest and walks it off.

reply.summary: Ntime is a small, kindly and perpetually flustered embassy clerk who saves his wages to bring his family abroad. He has no powers at all and survives on good manners and luck.

feats.scene: Ntime shoves a jammed filing cabinet shut with one clumsy swing of his shoulder.
Ntime tumbles down a flight of stairs with a tray of cups and stands up unhurt.

reply.summary: Telorcil is a greedy ex-daredevil flier who robs cargo and laboratories from the air. Rigged with a jet harness, she treats every heist as a stunt and kills without a flicker of remorse.

feats.scene: Telorcil rakes a transport helicopter with cannon fire until its cabin is a wreck.
Telorcil rides out a crash landing on a runway and limps off with a grin.
Telorcil banks her stolen plane low across the field faster than any chase car.

reply.summary: Amseor is an ancient schemer who boasts of swallowing a secret tonic and outliving centuries of history. Behind his walls he is nothing but a brittle old man who mistakes cunning for strength.

feats.scene: Amseor flings a heavy ledger across his study with a shaking arm.
Amseor endures one hard slap that his frail skull cannot answer.

reply.summary: Linval is a former soldier whose body was engineered to burst into a mindless yellow-eyed behemoth for an hour each day. He longs to be a hero but cannot steer the monster that wears his face.

feats.scene: Linval, in beast form, tears the front off a tower block with his bare hands.
Linval shrugs off a artillery volley that pulverises the street around him.

reply.summary: Colla is a teenage museum helper who can stretch like warm taffy and plays rescuer around town. His body pays a terrible price for the gift, ageing far faster than any child should.

feats.scene: Colla lashes an arm out half a block and snatches a bag from a fleeing thief.
Colla wraps himself around a runaway van and stretches until it stops.

reply.summary: Ereiarall is a small-town lawman who slid from duty into crime, shooting a rich patron and pinning it on an old schoolmate. He has no gifts beyond a badge, a pistol and a good reputation that he squandered.

feats.scene: Ereiarall fires his service revolver at close range across a quiet office.
Ereiarall is flung against a squad car and still reaches for his holster.

reply.summary: Niune is a scarred former child-minder and failed screen hopeful who stages her murders like silent films. She dresses in monochrome glamour and answers to a hidden backer who funds her fantasies.

feats.scene: Niune sweeps a prop sabre through a stage curtain and the man behind it.
Niune hits the theatre floor from a balcony rail and rises to take her bow.

reply.summary: Celvostor is a dry, careful physician who helps a mad professor build unnatural creatures in a sealed lab. She keeps her curiosity narrow and prefers not to ask where the orders lead.

feats.scene: Celvostor drives a syringe through a tough hide on the first try.
Celvostor is knocked flat by a startled test subject and gets up to adjust her glasses.

reply.summary: Austor is a horned fiend who joins a rebel cause, hitting hard enough to bloody a demigod and spitting brimstone from his throat. Wounds knit shut on him and he does not die of age.

feats.scene: Austor exhales a torrent of fire that melts a convoy of armoured trucks.
Austor crashes through a concrete wall from a single punch and licks the blood from his lip.

reply.summary: Strum is a fanged brick-bodied fiend sharing a mortal host, picked for team-ups by cheerful toy-block heroes. He leaps far, heals quickly and cannot abide the touch of iron.

feats.scene: Strum hurls a boulder-sized slab of masonry that flattens a gatehouse.
Strum is buried under a collapsing tower and claws his way out laughing.

reply.summary: Tortir is a tiny winged fiend kept as a pet by a mischievous boy sorcerer. He flutters along on visits and sneezes out bright gouts of flame when annoyed.

feats.scene: Tortir hiccups a jet of flame that torches a garden shed.
Tortir bounces off a closing door and shakes his horns as if nothing happened.

reply.summary: Lenluos is a tall, many-times-exiled fiend of royal blood, speaking in ragged couplets and bound to a human wanderer by an old magician. A rebel against his own court, he has served several banners and trusts none.

feats.scene: Lenluos brings a cavern roof down on an invading host with a single stamp.
Lenluos wades unmarked through a volcanic collapse and rhymes his scorn.

reply.summary: Cornau is a horned, red-eyed fiend who changes form on demand and works rough sorcery with claws and fangs. He turns up in cartoon crime stories as a menace for the local vigilante.

feats.scene: Cornau rakes his claws down a lamppost and slices it clean through.
Cornau is rammed by a truck and only gets angrier.

reply.summary: Iartelri is a cheerful pint-sized imp who lives deep underground and befriends children who share his love of flames. He speaks in sing-song and lights up when someone sets their hair alight.

feats.scene: Iartelri flares his hands and roasts a pile of sticks in a blink.
Iartelri sits in a bonfire and asks for more logs.

reply.summary: Savent is a fog-bound city worker whose husband drank their money away and vanished. She sold what she had to eat and was rescued from a killer by a kind gentleman who made her a nursemaid.

feats.scene: Savent slaps a drunk customer hard enough to drop him on the cobbles.
Savent scrambles through a narrow alley after a hard fall and keeps running.

reply.summary: Llustu is a stern castle priest who keeps a brotherhood of fanatics and the secrets they hide. His strength is doctrine and patience, not muscle.

feats.scene: Llustu strikes the stone floor with his staff and the sound rings through the hall.
Llustu kneels in an icy chapel overnight and rises without a shiver.

reply.summary: Reoanuveo is a seasoned island swordswoman and horse rider who meets an invading force with discipline. She falls in a battle against greater odds, still holding her blade.

feats.scene: Reoanuveo cleaves a wooden shield and the soldier behind it with one downward cut.
Reoanuveo shrugs off a musket ball that rattles her breastplate.

reply.summary: Vasvani is a high-ranking sentinel on a hidden island, expert with bow, blade and saddle, and a trusted friend of its champion. She trains hard and swims harder.

feats.scene: Vasvani looses an arrow that pins a bandit's banner to a cliff.
Vasvani shrugs off a rockfall on the cliff path and keeps climbing.

reply.summary: Niuaul is a deathless island fighter who wears a pair of bracelets and shares her friend's cause. Her hands are quick and her old wounds never seem to matter.

feats.scene: Niuaul snaps a spear shaft over her knee and drives the head home.
Niuaul deflects a stream of bullets off her bracelets without breaking stride.

reply.summary: Nuseo is a temple keeper who works out why her sisters are turning to stone and sends a plea to the gods. Her skill lies in reading omens, though she can fight if pressed.

feats.scene: Nuseo hurls a ceremonial spear through a bronze door.
Nuseo stands in a cold rain of falling marble dust and keeps chanting.

reply.summary: Rnreoium is a quiet schoolboy in a big foster family who, with his siblings, can shout a word and become a lightning-wielding adult hero. In that form he flies, hits hard and is very hard to hurt.

feats.scene: Rnreoium dives onto a parked bus and crushes it flat with a single landing.
Rnreoium takes a falling billboard on his back and brushes the glass off.
Rnreoium streaks over the suburbs and breaks the sound barrier with a crack.

reply.summary: Siteamo is a bookish boy who, joined by five friends, becomes one thunderous giant champion by speaking a magic word together. His share of the gift is deep wisdom.

feats.scene: Siteamo, merged with his friends, lifts a derailed train car over his head and sets it down.
Siteamo tanks a blast that cracks a bridge pier and then smiles at his friends.

reply.summary: Vosll is a gentle, disfigured teenager who wants only to be left alone and loved. He holds no powers, only a stubborn kindness in a very cruel world.

feats.scene: Vosll pushes a stuck door open with all his weight.
Vosll is beaten by a pack of older boys and picks up his glasses afterwards.

reply.summary: Ntnuria is a giddy mind-reader who drinks other people's sorrow and turns it into raw force. The more misery he swallows the stronger and madder he becomes, until he tries to feed on a whole city.

feats.scene: Ntnuria condenses the grief of thousands into a white pulse that gouges a plaza.
Ntnuria stands gleaming in a storm of rubble as it parts around his aura.

reply.summary: Sirrnull is a winged weather god with pink skin and pale eyes, lord of the morning gales from the horizon. He bonds his spirit to a mortal girl so that she may outlast her own death.

feats.scene: Sirrnull exhales a gale that lifts a fleet of ships and drops them far inland.
Sirrnull stands unmoved in the eye of a hurricane he did not make.

reply.summary: Irnorana is a snake-haired monster who haunts a maze with her sister and preys on lost travellers. Old legend clings to her, though a mortal hunter finally ends her.

feats.scene: Irnorana lunges and pins a wanderer to a wall with her talons.
Irnorana is struck by a thrown spear and keeps hissing.

reply.summary: Collino is a lean warrior from an island of archers who befriends a young visitor she is meant to train. She holds no grudge when that friend refuses to join the war party.

feats.scene: Collino looses three arrows in the time it takes to blink.
Collino is thrown through a market stall in a brawl and rolls upright.

reply.summary: Lonern is a young bride whose death breaks her musician husband's heart. She appears mostly in memory, a pale figure in a tale of loss and song.

feats.scene: Lonern tosses a handful of grain across a threshing floor.
Lonern collapses from a snakebite and gives way to the dark.

reply.summary: Llolle is a blond twin enforcer hired to break a poisoner out of her cell with a miracle seed tonic. She is nimble enough to dodge pistol fire while hurling blades.

feats.scene: Llolle flicks three knives into a wooden beam in a tight cluster.
Llolle takes a vicious beating and is still on her feet to count the cash.

reply.summary: Tonlueo is a corporate aide who carries a secret life as a spy, casting mental masks that make her look like someone else. She turns on her bosses and pays for it.

feats.scene: Tonlueo hurls a desk lamp across a boardroom to cover her escape.
Tonlueo grits her teeth through a hard fall down a stairwell.

reply.summary: Nolar is a worried hospital administrator and divorced mother who frets over her daughter after a traumatic night. She has no unusual gifts and no desire for any.

feats.scene: Nolar slams a ledger onto a desk to end an argument.
Nolar takes a tumble on a wet corridor floor and laughs it off.

reply.summary: Vaoraeon is a pink-eyed automaton girl with hazy memories of her own ending. Her nano-built body mimics living tissue so well that even expert tinkerers puzzle over it.

feats.scene: Vaoraeon punches a hole through a bulkhead that a crew could not cut.
Vaoraeon holds up a collapsing gantry and walks out of the dust unscratched.

reply.summary: Nenseoiar is a rich socialite and former medal-winning tumbler who steals paintings by night. He later throws a fortune into a bog rather than keep money tainted by death.

feats.scene: Nenseoiar vaults a rail and kicks a guard off a rooftop ledge.
Nenseoiar rolls off a gallery skylight and lands lightly on his feet.

reply.summary: Lasrauveo is a baby born of strange glowing rocks who ages in days, racing toward an early grave. His birth blast wipes out his mother and her car.

feats.scene: Lasrauveo bursts in a white flash that vaporises a car in an open field.
Lasrauveo lies unharmed in the crater of his own making.

reply.summary: Cornumra is a roguish thief with a glass-bending gadget that lets him slip into a reflected realm and crop up in many places. He is a coward at heart and bargains for survival in a plague-ridden world.

feats.scene: Cornumra fires his gadget and splinters a wall of windows into a bright storm.
Cornumra slips into a pane just ahead of a lunging horde.

reply.summary: Tiutiiu is a mirror-hopping criminal fatally hurt in a duel and trapped in the glass world to live out his last hours. From there he springs a gang from prison to take revenge.

feats.scene: Tiutiiu fires his glass gun and cracks the bars of a prison cell.
Tiutiiu soaks a crushing frost blast that would have killed anyone else outright.

reply.summary: Eovor is an orange-skinned patrol officer from a star-faring commonwealth who investigates a lost rescue beacon. She is loyal to her partner and sometimes too quick to assume a stranger is raving.

feats.scene: Eovor stuns an armoured fugitive with a pulse from her sidearm that scorches the wall behind him.
Eovor takes a bruising hit from a powered fist and keeps her footing.

reply.summary: Eonri is a raven-haired first mother who has outlived empires and keeps company with a lord of dreams. She tells stories to the dead and the living alike and is never afraid of the proud.

feats.scene: Eonri heaves a stone slab aside to bury a grieving child's brother.
Eonri walks barefoot through a collapsing desert pavilion and emerges untouched.

reply.summary: Ianlleo is a deathless woman present at the dawn of her people, a teller of tales who keeps a home inside a realm of dreams. Her calm comes from having seen it all.

feats.scene: Ianlleo shakes a heavy rug and a whole season of dust flies out.
Ianlleo sits unmoved as a ceiling of dream-stone comes down around her.

reply.summary: Sevas is a blond college girl who once ran errands for a military office and was blackmailed into handing over a secret report. She later makes amends among a loud group of loyal classmates.

feats.scene: Sevas snatches an envelope and sprints across a station platform.
Sevas runs headlong into a crowd of classmates and is pinned but unhurt.

reply.summary: Sorti is a naval officer's daughter and trained nurse who flies a fighting submarine-plane beside her fiance. She is a crack shot who can snap a chain across a room.

feats.scene: Sorti fires one pistol round that severs a chain across a warehouse.
Sorti rides out a rough sea landing and tends the wounded afterward.

reply.summary: Ntoriill is a grey-haired mother whose son died in a cruel experiment. Grief pushes her and her husband to take revenge on a radio personality before they give themselves up.

feats.scene: Ntoriill hands over the pistol that ends a broadcast mid-sentence.
Ntoriill sits through a long night of questioning without flinching.

reply.summary: Annto is a masked adventurer and politician's daughter who holds a seat on an elite hero squad while her mother's memory fades. She resents being told to hang up the cape.

feats.scene: Annto drives a flying kick into a tunnel wall beside a masked rival.
Annto takes a brutal beating from a stronger fighter and still stares him down.

reply.summary: Talos is a gloom-wielding vigilante drafted into a gladiator contest by a cruel overseer. She tries to save a double and is torn apart by a swarm of living darkness.

feats.scene: Talos hurls a wave of living gloom that flattens a squad of gladiators.
Talos is pinned beneath a swarm that tears at her limbs until she bleeds out.

reply.summary: Leostton is a crime-fighting recruit in a team bent on ending all villains for good. She dies in the burst of a vast energy release that scours a whole plain.

feats.scene: Leostton cracks a restraining baton across a captive's jaw.
Leostton is shoved to the ground by a lurching prisoner and rolls up again.

reply.summary: Tiuast is a half-royal fighter of two worlds who steps through gloom to open doors anywhere. She reads like a ghost in a body of living night and has trained her hands as well as her magic.

feats.scene: Tiuast opens a rift under a warship and drops it into a canyon.
Tiuast turns to a silhouette as a demolition charge bursts through her.

reply.summary: Estor is an elder being of vast might who was walled away until a disturbance freed her. She bends reality, hurls raw force and nearly levels a capital before her own will ends it.

feats.scene: Estor rewrites a boulevard into glass and blasts a whole district to dust.
Estor strolls through a barrage of heroes' blows without a mark.

reply.summary: Oroteam is a wingless princess of a hidden frozen city who escapes its conquerors and takes a plain new name. She wants only a normal life among ordinary classmates.

feats.scene: Oroteam clambers into a cargo hold and heaves a crate aside to hide behind it.
Oroteam endures a bitter blizzard on the ice shelf and keeps running.
